name: Flutter
description_en:
Flutter is a free, open-source application UI framework built around Dart and composable widgets. It targets mobile, web and desktop applications from a shared codebase, with platform integration where needed. It is a developer framework, not a hosted no-code builder or an automatically operated backend.

Sharing UI and logic can reduce duplication, but plugins, native APIs, toolchains, deployment and testing still depend on each target. The official pages read here describe Flutter 3.47; no SDK, application or device was installed or run for this profile.
description_zh:
Flutter 是以 Dart 及可组合 widget 构建的免费开源应用 UI 框架，可共享代码开发移动、Web、桌面应用，并按需集成平台能力。它是开发框架，不是托管无代码构建器或自动代运维后端。

共享 UI 和逻辑可减少重复，但插件、原生 API、工具链、部署及测试仍依目标平台。已读官方页面标注 Flutter 3.47，本档案未安装或运行 SDK、应用及设备。

sections.title_en: Build a small interaction before targeting every platform
sections.title_zh: 先构建小交互，再覆盖各平台
sections.en: A proposed evaluation could build a task list with an empty state, add/edit behavior and a failed save message. Set up the SDK/editor, create a project, run it on one target and inspect the widget tree. The official setup guide uses a counter change to illustrate the edit/run loop. Then separate shared presentation/state from backend calls and platform integrations. A single codebase does not supply the application’s authentication, persistence or business validation automatically. This example was not executed.
sections.zh: 建议用任务列表试验：包含空状态、添加／编辑及保存失败提示。先设置 SDK／编辑器、创建项目、在一个目标运行并检查 widget 树。官方设置以计数器变化说明编辑／运行循环。再区分共享展示／状态、后端调用及平台集成。单代码库不会自动提供认证、持久化或业务校验。本例未执行。

sections.title_en: Hot reload is not a clean-start test
sections.title_zh: 热重载不等于全新启动测试
sections.en: Hot reload preserves application state and rebuilds the widget tree. It does not rerun main or initState, and global/static initializers can retain earlier values. Native Kotlin/Java/Swift/Objective-C changes need a full restart. A page that looks correct after reload may therefore behave differently on a clean launch. Test both the rapid edit loop and a fresh start after initialization changes; do not treat preserved login or stale state as evidence that startup and session restoration work.
sections.zh: 热重载保留应用状态并重建 widget 树，但不会重跑 main、initState，全局／静态初始化也可保留旧值。原生 Kotlin／Java／Swift／Objective-C 改动需完整重启。因此重载后看似正确的页面，全新启动可能不同。初始化变化后应同时检查快速编辑循环与新启动，不能把保留登录或旧状态当作启动／会话恢复正确证据。

sections.title_en: Shared code still needs target-specific capability checks
sections.title_zh: 共享代码仍需逐平台检查能力
sections.en: Web has no normal device file-system access, dart:io Platform checks can throw UnsupportedError, and Flutter web does not currently offer Dart isolates. Plugins may need conditional imports or other implementations. iOS setup requires Xcode on a Mac, signing and a device/simulator workflow; distribution has separate developer-account requirements. Start by listing camera, files, background work and native UI needs, then verify each required package/target combination rather than assuming a mobile package works unchanged in a browser.
sections.zh: Web 无普通设备文件系统访问，dart:io Platform 检查可抛 UnsupportedError，当前 Flutter Web 也不提供 Dart isolate。插件可能需条件导入或另一实现。iOS 设置需 Mac 上 Xcode、签名及设备／模拟器流程，分发另有开发者账号要求。应先列相机、文件、后台及原生 UI 需求，逐包／目标核对，不假设移动插件在浏览器可原样运行。

sections.title_en: Choose tests that actually cover the user interaction
sections.title_zh: 选择真正覆盖用户交互的测试
sections.en: A unit test checks isolated logic; a widget test checks component layout/interaction in a simplified environment; integration tests exercise larger app flows on a device or emulator. The SDK integration_test package cannot interact with native permission dialogs, notifications or platform views according to the testing guide. A passing widget test therefore cannot prove camera permission or operating-system UI behavior. Include the target-specific success, denial and error path, then assess release-mode behavior instead of using debug responsiveness as a performance claim.
sections.zh: 单元测试检查隔离逻辑，widget 测试在简化环境检查布局／交互，集成测试在设备或模拟器检查更大流程。测试指南说明 SDK integration_test 无法操作原生权限对话框、通知或平台视图。因此 widget 测试通过不能证明相机权限或系统 UI 行为。需包含逐平台成功、拒绝及错误路径，再评估 release 行为，不能用 debug 响应作性能结论。

sections.title_en: Web deployment can leave an old app in users’ browsers
sections.title_zh: Web 部署后用户浏览器可能仍有旧应用
sections.en: The web FAQ warns that browser/CDN cache lifetimes can retain an old app after deployment and leave it incompatible with a newer backend. Check cache headers and the actual served version. Newer Flutter versions do not generate/manage an offline service worker by default; offline behavior needs separate implementation. A successful build/upload is not evidence that all clients refreshed or that offline data works. Test a returning browser, a missing asset and a clean browser before releasing a backend-breaking change.
sections.zh: Web FAQ 警告浏览器／CDN 缓存可在部署后保留旧应用，与新后端不兼容。需检查缓存头及实际提供版本。新版 Flutter 默认不生成／管理离线 service worker，离线能力需另实现。构建／上传成功不能证明所有客户端刷新，或离线数据可用。后端破坏性变化前应检查回访浏览器、缺失资源及干净浏览器。

sections.title_en: Framework license cost is different from shipping cost
sections.title_zh: 框架许可费不同于交付成本
sections.en: The official FAQ states Flutter is free and available under BSD 3-Clause. It separately explains engine/framework dependencies and application license notices; the website footer’s content/sample licenses are not a substitute for a package inventory. There is no framework seat price to normalize here. Engineering, devices, target SDKs, app-store distribution, backend services, hosting and third-party packages can still create costs and terms. The iOS guide distinguishes free personal device testing from App Store distribution; exact store fees were not researched.
sections.zh: 官方 FAQ 声明 Flutter 免费、BSD 3-Clause，并另述引擎／框架依赖及应用许可告知；网站页脚的内容／示例许可不能替代包清单。此处无框架席位价可归一，但开发、设备、目标 SDK、应用商店分发、后端、托管及第三方包仍有成本或条款。iOS 指南区分免费个人设备测试与 App Store 分发，本次未研究商店具体费用。
